---
title: "`r params$report_title`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    highlight: tango
    toc: false
    self_contained: true
params:
  result: NULL
  report_title: "PERSEO Analysis Report"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center")

library(htmltools)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)

result <- params$result
de     <- result$differential_expression
fs     <- result$family_selection
smry   <- result$summary

has_contrasts <- !is.null(de$contrasts) && nrow(de$contrasts) > 0
has_omnibus   <- !is.null(de$omnibus)   && nrow(de$omnibus)   > 0

pkg_version <- tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion("PERSEO")),
                        error = function(e) "dev")

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# ---- Extract and normalise data --------------------------------------------

results_df   <- de$results   %||% data.frame()
contrasts_df <- de$contrasts %||% data.frame()

# Normalise column names
if ("padj" %in% names(results_df) && !"p_adj" %in% names(results_df))
  results_df$p_adj <- results_df$padj
if ("pval" %in% names(results_df) && !"p_value" %in% names(results_df))
  results_df$p_value <- results_df$pval

# ---- Unified significance thresholds (single source of truth) -------------
# These values drive KPI cards, volcano colours, contrast counters, and Venn sets.

.fdr_threshold <- 0.05
.lfc_threshold <- 1.0

n_features  <- nrow(de$selection %||% data.frame())
n_families  <- length(fs$top_families_overall)

if (has_contrasts) {
  sig_features <- unique(contrasts_df$feature[
    !is.na(contrasts_df$p_adj) &
    contrasts_df$p_adj < .fdr_threshold &
    abs(contrasts_df$estimate) >= .lfc_threshold
  ])
  sig_source_label <- paste0(
    "FDR&nbsp;&lt;&nbsp;", .fdr_threshold,
    " &amp; |LFC|&nbsp;&ge;&nbsp;", .lfc_threshold,
    " in &ge;1 contrast")
} else if (nrow(results_df) > 0 && "p_adj" %in% names(results_df)) {
  r_ni <- results_df[!is.na(results_df$term) & results_df$term != "(Intercept)" &
                       !is.na(results_df$p_adj) & results_df$p_adj < .fdr_threshold, ]
  sig_features     <- unique(r_ni$feature)
  sig_source_label <- paste0("FDR&nbsp;&lt;&nbsp;", .fdr_threshold,
                              " (coefficients, intercept excluded)")
} else {
  sig_features     <- character(0)
  sig_source_label <- "N/A"
}

n_sig       <- length(sig_features)
n_contrasts <- if (has_contrasts) length(unique(contrasts_df$contrast)) else 0L

# ---- Contrast metadata -----------------------------------------------------

contrast_names <- if (has_contrasts) unique(contrasts_df$contrast) else character(0)
contrast_slugs <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "-", contrast_names)

show_comparison <- has_contrasts && length(contrast_names) >= 2

has_jsonlite <- requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)

# ---- Master results table --------------------------------------------------

master_rows <- list()

if (nrow(results_df) > 0) {
  rsub <- results_df[!is.na(results_df$term) & results_df$term != "(Intercept)", ,
                     drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(rsub) > 0) {
    eff_col  <- intersect(c("effect", "estimate"), names(rsub))[1]
    stat_col <- intersect(c("stat", "z"),          names(rsub))[1]
    pv_col   <- intersect(c("p_value", "pval"),    names(rsub))[1]
    pa_col   <- intersect(c("p_adj",   "padj"),    names(rsub))[1]

    master_rows[["coef"]] <- data.frame(
      Feature       = rsub$feature,
      Type          = "Coefficient",
      Contrast_Term = rsub$term,
      Estimate      = if (!is.na(eff_col))  rsub[[eff_col]]  else NA_real_,
      SE            = if ("se" %in% names(rsub)) rsub$se      else NA_real_,
      Stat          = if (!is.na(stat_col)) rsub[[stat_col]] else NA_real_,
      P_value       = if (!is.na(pv_col))  rsub[[pv_col]]   else NA_real_,
      P_adj         = if (!is.na(pa_col))  rsub[[pa_col]]   else NA_real_,
      Family        = if (!is.null(de$selection))
                        de$selection$best_family[match(rsub$feature,
                                                       de$selection$feature)]
                      else NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

if (has_contrasts && nrow(contrasts_df) > 0) {
  master_rows[["cont"]] <- data.frame(
    Feature       = contrasts_df$feature,
    Type          = "Contrast",
    Contrast_Term = contrasts_df$contrast,
    Estimate      = contrasts_df$estimate,
    SE            = if ("se"      %in% names(contrasts_df)) contrasts_df$se      else NA_real_,
    Stat          = if ("z"       %in% names(contrasts_df)) contrasts_df$z       else NA_real_,
    P_value       = if ("p_value" %in% names(contrasts_df)) contrasts_df$p_value else NA_real_,
    P_adj         = if ("p_adj"   %in% names(contrasts_df)) contrasts_df$p_adj   else NA_real_,
    Family        = if (!is.null(de$selection))
                      de$selection$best_family[match(contrasts_df$feature,
                                                     de$selection$feature)]
                    else NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

master_tbl <- do.call(rbind, master_rows)
if (!is.null(master_tbl) && nrow(master_tbl) > 0) {
  master_tbl$Estimate <- signif(master_tbl$Estimate, 4)
  master_tbl$SE       <- signif(master_tbl$SE,       4)
  master_tbl$Stat     <- round(master_tbl$Stat,      3)
  master_tbl$P_value  <- signif(master_tbl$P_value,  3)
  master_tbl$P_adj    <- signif(master_tbl$P_adj,    3)
}

# ---- Family information lookup ---------------------------------------------

.family_info <- list(
  NBI    = list(full = "Negative Binomial Type I",    type = "Count",
                desc = "Overdispersed counts (variance > mean). Typical for RNA-seq."),
  PO     = list(full = "Poisson",                     type = "Count",
                desc = "Equidispersed counts (variance = mean)."),
  ZIP    = list(full = "Zero-Inflated Poisson",        type = "Count",
                desc = "Excess zeros + equidispersed non-zero counts."),
  ZINBI  = list(full = "Zero-Inflated Neg. Binomial", type = "Count",
                desc = "Excess zeros + overdispersed non-zero counts."),
  ZIP2   = list(full = "Zero-Inflated Poisson 2",     type = "Count",
                desc = "Alternative parametrisation of zero-inflated Poisson."),
  BI     = list(full = "Binomial",                    type = "Count",
                desc = "Binary outcomes or proportions with known denominator."),
  BB     = list(full = "Beta-Binomial",               type = "Count",
                desc = "Overdispersed proportions with known denominator."),
  GA     = list(full = "Gamma",                       type = "Positive continuous",
                desc = "Positive continuous, right-skewed (e.g. TPM, RPKM)."),
  GG     = list(full = "Generalized Gamma",           type = "Positive continuous",
                desc = "Positive continuous, flexible shape; generalises Gamma, Log-Normal, Inverse Gaussian."),
  LOGNO  = list(full = "Log-Normal",                  type = "Positive continuous",
                desc = "Positive continuous; log(y) follows a Normal distribution. Common for mass-spec intensities."),
  IG     = list(full = "Inverse Gaussian",            type = "Positive continuous",
                desc = "Positive continuous, strongly right-skewed."),
  BE     = list(full = "Beta",                        type = "Unit interval",
                desc = "Proportions in (0,1) without point mass at 0 or 1. DNA methylation beta-values."),
  BEINF  = list(full = "Beta Inflated (0 and 1)",     type = "Unit interval",
                desc = "Proportions in [0,1] with point mass at both 0 and 1."),
  BEO    = list(full = "Beta Inflated at 1",          type = "Unit interval",
                desc = "Proportions in [0,1] with point mass at 1."),
  BEZI   = list(full = "Beta Zero-Inflated",          type = "Unit interval",
                desc = "Proportions in [0,1] with point mass at 0."),
  BEo    = list(full = "Beta Inflated at 0",          type = "Unit interval",
                desc = "Proportions in [0,1] with point mass at 0 (alternative parametrisation)."),
  BEINF0 = list(full = "Beta Inflated at 0 (0-1)",    type = "Unit interval",
                desc = "Proportions in [0,1] with point mass at 0."),
  NO     = list(full = "Normal (Gaussian)",            type = "Real-valued",
                desc = "Symmetric real-valued data. Appropriate for log- or VST-transformed data."),
  TF     = list(full = "t Family",                    type = "Real-valued",
                desc = "Real-valued, heavy tails. Robust to outliers."),
  GU     = list(full = "Gumbel",                      type = "Real-valued",
                desc = "Real-valued extreme-value distribution.")
)

family_badge <- function(fam) {
  info <- .family_info[[fam]]
  if (is.null(info)) return(htmlEscape(fam))
  sprintf('<span class="family-badge" title="%s (%s) \u2014 %s">%s</span>',
          htmlEscape(info$full), htmlEscape(info$type),
          htmlEscape(info$desc), htmlEscape(fam))
}

# ---- UI helpers ------------------------------------------------------------

info_box <- function(title, body) {
  paste0(
    '<details class="perseo-info-box">',
    '<summary class="perseo-info-summary">',
    '<span class="info-icon">&#9432;</span> ', title,
    '</summary>',
    '<div class="perseo-info-body">', body, '</div>',
    '</details>'
  )
}

kpi <- function(value, label, note = NULL, sig = FALSE) {
  cls      <- if (sig) "kpi-box kpi-sig" else "kpi-box"
  note_html <- if (!is.null(note))
    paste0('<div class="kpi-note">', note, '</div>') else ""
  paste0('<div class="', cls, '">',
         '<div class="kpi-value">', value, '</div>',
         '<div class="kpi-label">', label, '</div>',
         note_html, '</div>')
}

badge <- function(val, tl = "Yes", fl = "No",
                  tc = "#27AE60", fc = "#888888") {
  col   <- if (isTRUE(val)) tc else fc
  label <- if (isTRUE(val)) tl else fl
  sprintf('<span class="param-badge" style="background:%s">%s</span>', col, label)
}

prow <- function(name, value, desc) {
  vstr <- if (is.character(value) || is.numeric(value))
    paste0('<code>', paste(as.character(value), collapse = ", "), '</code>')
  else value
  paste0('<tr><td class="param-name">', name, '</td>',
         '<td class="param-value">', vstr, '</td>',
         '<td class="param-desc">',  desc, '</td></tr>')
}

ph <- function(label)
  paste0('<tr class="param-section-header"><td colspan="3">', label, '</td></tr>')

# ---- Custom sidebar HTML --------------------------------------------------

nav_links <- c(
  '<a href="#s0">0 &mdash; Parameters</a>',
  '<a href="#s1">1 &mdash; Summary</a>',
  '<a href="#s2">2 &mdash; Family Selection</a>',
  '<a href="#s3">3 &mdash; Differential Expression</a>',
  '<a href="#s4">4 &mdash; Contrasts</a>'
)
for (i in seq_along(contrast_names)) {
  nav_links <- c(nav_links,
    sprintf('<a href="#c-%s" class="nav-sub" title="%s">%s</a>',
            contrast_slugs[i],
            htmlEscape(contrast_names[i]),
            if (nchar(contrast_names[i]) > 28)
              paste0(substr(contrast_names[i], 1, 26), "&hellip;")
            else htmlEscape(contrast_names[i])))
}
if (show_comparison)
  nav_links <- c(nav_links, '<a href="#s5">5 &mdash; Comparison</a>')

sidebar_html <- paste0(
  '<nav class="perseo-sidenav" id="perseo-nav">',
  '<div class="sidenav-brand">PERSEO</div>',
  paste(nav_links, collapse = "\n"),
  '</nav>'
)

# ---- Plot helpers ----------------------------------------------------------

.perseo_colours <- c(
  not_sig  = "#BBBBBB",
  lfc_only = "#888888",
  fdr_only = "#56B4E9",
  sig_lfc  = "#0072B2"
)

classify_colour <- function(estimate, p_adj,
                            fdr = .fdr_threshold,
                            lfc = .lfc_threshold) {
  out <- rep(unname(.perseo_colours["not_sig"]), length(estimate))
  ok  <- is.finite(estimate) & is.finite(p_adj)
  al  <- abs(estimate)
  out[ok & p_adj <  fdr & al >= lfc] <- unname(.perseo_colours["sig_lfc"])
  out[ok & p_adj <  fdr & al <  lfc] <- unname(.perseo_colours["fdr_only"])
  out[ok & p_adj >= fdr & al >= lfc] <- unname(.perseo_colours["lfc_only"])
  out
}

emit_chart <- function(id, type, payload, min_h = "360px",
                       extra_class = "") {
  json <- jsonlite::toJSON(payload, dataframe = "rows",
                           na = "null", auto_unbox = TRUE)
  htmltools::HTML(sprintf(paste0(
    '<div id="%s" class="perseo-chart %s" data-chart-type="%s" ',
    'style="width:100%%;min-height:%s;"></div>\n',
    '<script type="application/json" id="cfg-%s">%s</script>\n'),
    id, extra_class, type, min_h, id, json))
}
```

```{r embed-echarts, results='asis'}
# Inline the ECharts bundle so the HTML stays self-contained.
ecdir <- system.file("templates", "assets", "echarts.min.js",
                     package = "PERSEO")
if (!nzchar(ecdir) || !file.exists(ecdir)) {
  ecdir <- file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)),
                     "assets", "echarts.min.js")
}
if (file.exists(ecdir)) {
  ec <- paste(readLines(ecdir, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"),
              collapse = "\n")
  cat("<script>", ec, "</script>\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("<script src=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@5.5.1/dist/echarts.min.js\"></script>\n")
}
```

```{r header}
      '&nbsp;&nbsp;&bull;&nbsp;&nbsp;', format(Sys.time(), "%B %d, %Y"),
    '</p>
  </div>
</div>
<p class="perseo-intro">
  <strong>PERSEO</strong> is a model-aware differential expression framework for omics data.
  Unlike conventional pipelines (DESeq2, edgeR, limma) that force <em>all</em> features
  into a single statistical family (e.g. Negative Binomial for all genes in RNA-seq),
  PERSEO evaluates up to 18 different
  <abbr title="Generalised Additive Models for Location, Scale and Shape">GAMLSS</abbr>
  families and selects the best-fitting distribution <em>per feature</em>.
  This makes PERSEO suitable for heterogeneous datasets where different features may follow
  count, continuous-positive, proportion, or real-valued distributions &mdash; even within
  the same experiment. Use the left panel to navigate between sections.
</p>
'))
```

<div id="s0" class="sec-anchor"></div>

# 0 &mdash; Analysis Parameters

> **Full record of all parameters used in this analysis.** Intended for reproducibility
> and methods reporting. Each parameter is shown alongside a brief explanation.

```{r params-table}
s <- smry

tm_desc <- switch(s$transform_mode %||% "strict",
  "strict" = "Only families whose mathematical support exactly matches the observed data
              range are evaluated per feature. Safest choice for heterogeneous omics data.",
  "safe"   = "Broader family matching with log/logit rescaling where needed. More
              permissive; suitable when support mismatches are expected.",
  s$transform_mode)

crit_desc <- switch(s$criterion %||% "GAIC",
  "GAIC" = paste0("Generalised AIC with penalty k = ", s$gaic_k %||% "?",
                  ". Balances fit and complexity; recommended for omics."),
  "BIC"  = "Bayesian Information Criterion — stronger complexity penalty than AIC.",
  "AIC"  = "Akaike Information Criterion — standard penalised likelihood.",
  s$criterion)

padj_desc <- switch(s$p_adjust_method %||% "BH",
  "BH"         = "Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control. Recommended for high-dimensional data.",
  "bonferroni" = "Bonferroni correction. Very conservative for large feature sets.",
  "none"        = "No adjustment applied.",
  s$p_adjust_method)

rows <- paste0(
  ph("Data"),
  prow("Features", format(s$n_features_total %||% "?", big.mark = ","),
       "Total genomic features in the input counts matrix."),
  prow("Samples", format(s$n_samples %||% "?", big.mark = ","),
       "Total samples (columns) in the counts matrix."),
  ph("Family Selection"),
  prow("Bootstrap", badge(s$bootstrap),
       "<strong>Yes</strong>: families evaluated on random feature subsets
        (n_genes &times; n_boot pulls). Faster and more robust.
        <strong>No</strong>: all features evaluated (comprehensive but slower)."),
  prow("Features per pull (n_genes)", s$n_features_sampled %||% "&mdash;",
       "Features randomly sampled per bootstrap pull."),
  prow("Bootstrap pulls (n_boot)", s$n_bootstrap_pulls %||% "&mdash;",
       "Independent resamples. More pulls &rarr; more stable frequency estimates."),
  prow("Top N families (top_n)", s$top_n %||% "&mdash;",
       "Top-ranked families passed to the differential expression step."),
  prow("Group by support", badge(s$group_by_support),
       "Restricts candidates to families compatible with each feature's data range
        (e.g. count families for integer data, Beta for proportions)."),
  prow("Zero-inflation threshold", s$thr_zero %||% "&mdash;",
       "Min proportion of exact zeros to activate zero-inflated families (ZIP, ZINBI)."),
  prow("One-inflation threshold",  s$thr_one  %||% "&mdash;",
       "Min proportion of exact ones to activate one-inflated families (BEINF)."),
  prow("Candidate families",
       if (identical(s$families_candidate, "default")) "Default set (18 families)"
       else paste(s$families_candidate, collapse = ", "),
       "Distributional families evaluated during bootstrap family selection."),
  prow("Selected families", paste(s$families_selected %||% "?", collapse = ", "),
       "Families carried forward to the differential expression model fitting step."),
  ph("Model Fitting"),
  prow("Information criterion", s$criterion %||% "?", crit_desc),
  prow("Transform mode", paste0('<code>', s$transform_mode %||% "?", '</code>'), tm_desc),
  prow("Min. valid observations (min_n)", s$min_n %||% "&mdash;",
       "Features with fewer valid observations after masking are skipped."),
  ph("Contrasts &amp; Omnibus Test"),
  prow("Contrast matrix supplied", badge(s$has_contrast_matrix),
       "Whether a user-defined numeric contrast matrix was provided."),
  prow("Contrast variable", s$contrast_variable %||% "<em>none</em>",
       "Variable for which all pairwise contrasts are auto-generated. <code>none</code>
        means a manual contrast matrix was provided or no contrasts requested."),
  prow("Omnibus test", badge(s$omnibus),
       "<strong>Yes</strong>: a joint Wald/LRT test is run per feature before contrasts;
        only features that pass (p &lt; threshold) proceed to pairwise comparisons."),
  prow("Omnibus test type",  as.character(s$omnibus_test %||% "&mdash;"),
       "Wald (fast, uses covariance matrix of fitted model) or Likelihood Ratio Test
        (more robust for small n; requires refitting a reduced model)."),
  prow("Omnibus threshold",  as.character(s$omnibus_threshold %||% "&mdash;"),
       "p-value cut-off for the omnibus gatekeeper filter."),
  ph("Multiple Testing Correction"),
  prow("Method", s$p_adjust_method %||% "?", padj_desc),
  ph("Parallelisation"),
  prow("Parallel", badge(s$parallel),
       "Feature-level model fitting parallelised via the <code>future</code> backend."),
  prow("Workers", as.character(s$workers %||% "&mdash;"),
       "Number of parallel workers used. <code>&mdash;</code> if parallelisation disabled."),
  ph("Execution"),
  prow("Run timestamp", s$run_timestamp %||% "&mdash;",
       "Date and time the analysis was executed."),
  prow("PERSEO version", pkg_version,
       "Package version used to generate this report.")
)

HTML(paste0(
  '<table class="param-table">',
  '<thead><tr>',
  '<th style="width:23%">Parameter</th>',
  '<th style="width:17%">Value</th>',
  '<th>Description</th>',
  '</tr></thead>',
  '<tbody>', rows, '</tbody>',
  '</table>'
))
```

<div id="s2" class="sec-anchor"></div>

# 2 &mdash; Family Selection

> **Distribution of best-fitting GAMLSS families across all features.** PERSEO evaluates
> multiple candidate families and selects the one with the lowest Jacobian-corrected
> information criterion per feature. Hover over bars for exact counts.

```{r s2-infobox, results='asis'}
cat(info_box(
  "How family selection works",
  paste0(
    "<p>PERSEO tests each candidate family on a feature using the same set of valid ",
    "observations (the <em>common mask</em> &mdash; intersection of all family validity ",
    "masks). Each family transforms the response to its natural domain, then fits an ",
    "intercept-only GAMLSS model and computes a <strong>Jacobian-corrected information ",
    "criterion</strong> (IC). The Jacobian correction ensures the IC values are ",
    "comparable on the <em>original data scale</em>, not the transformed scale &mdash; ",
    "this is essential for a fair comparison across families with different supports ",
    "(counts, proportions, positive-continuous, real-valued).</p>",
    "<p>Because evaluating all families on all features would be computationally ",
    "expensive, PERSEO uses a <strong>bootstrap</strong> step: it samples ",
    "<code>n_genes</code> random features for <code>n_boot</code> independent pulls, ",
    "records which family wins most often, and passes the top <code>top_n</code> ",
    "families to the full differential expression step. Features with different ",
    "data characteristics (e.g. some following a Negative Binomial, others a Gamma ",
    "distribution) will end up with different best-fitting families.</p>",
    "<p><strong>Support categories:</strong> Count (non-negative integers) &bull; ",
    "Unit interval (values in [0,1]) &bull; Positive continuous (y&nbsp;&gt;&nbsp;0) ",
    "&bull; Real-valued (&minus;&infin; to +&infin;).</p>"
  )
))
```

```{r family-barplot}
sel_df <- de$selection
# Shared palette for families — same order used by IC histogram.
.fam_palette <- c("#2C3E50", "#2980B9", "#17A589", "#5D6D7E", "#5DADE2",
                  "#48C9B0", "#34495E", "#85C1E9", "#76D7C4", "#85929E",
                  "#1A5276", "#0E6251", "#AEB6BF", "#AED6F1", "#A3E4D7")
.fam_colour_map <- local({
  all_fams <- if (!is.null(sel_df) && "best_family" %in% names(sel_df))
    sort(unique(sel_df$best_family)) else character(0)
  setNames(.fam_palette[(seq_along(all_fams) - 1L) %% length(.fam_palette) + 1L],
           all_fams)
})

if (!is.null(sel_df) && nrow(sel_df) > 0 && "best_family" %in% names(sel_df)) {
  fi_lookup <- vapply(names(.family_info), function(k) .family_info[[k]]$full,
                      character(1))
  fam_counts <- sel_df %>%
    dplyr::count(family = best_family, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    mutate(
      pct    = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
      full   = unname(fi_lookup[match(family, names(fi_lookup))]),
      colour = unname(.fam_colour_map[match(family, names(.fam_colour_map))])
    )

  emit_chart("chart-family-bar", "family_bar",
             list(rows = fam_counts),
             min_h = paste0(max(300, 32 * nrow(fam_counts) + 60), "px"),
             extra_class = "chart-wide")
}
```

```{r ic-histogram, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(sel_df) && nrow(sel_df) > 0 &&
    "ic_value" %in% names(sel_df) && "best_family" %in% names(sel_df)) {
  ic_finite <- sel_df[is.finite(sel_df$ic_value), ]
  if (nrow(ic_finite) > 10) {
    cat(info_box(
      "How to read the IC histogram",
      paste0(
        "<p>Each bar shows how many features had a given ",
        "information criterion (IC &mdash; BIC or AIC depending on ",
        "<code>criterion</code>) for their <em>best-fitting</em> family. ",
        "A tight, left-skewed distribution means most models fit well. ",
        "A long right tail or multi-modal shape indicates a heterogeneous ",
        "dataset where different feature blocks require very different models.</p>",
        "<p>Colours match the family bar chart above: each family is stacked in the ",
        "same colour, so you can see which families dominate at low IC (good fit) ",
        "versus high IC (poor fit). <strong>Low IC = better fit</strong>; the ",
        "Jacobian correction ensures IC values are comparable across families ",
        "even when transformations are applied.</p>"
      )
    ))

    rng <- range(ic_finite$ic_value)
    nbins <- 40
    breaks <- seq(rng[1], rng[2], length.out = nbins + 1)
    mids   <- (head(breaks, -1) + tail(breaks, -1)) / 2
    families <- sort(unique(ic_finite$best_family))
    series <- lapply(families, function(f) {
      vv  <- ic_finite$ic_value[ic_finite$best_family == f]
      cnt <- as.integer(table(cut(vv, breaks = breaks,
                                  include.lowest = TRUE)))
      list(name   = f,
           colour = unname(.fam_colour_map[f]),
           counts = cnt)
    })
    emit_chart("chart-ic-hist", "ic_hist",
               list(bin_mids = signif(mids, 5),
                    series   = series),
               min_h = "360px", extra_class = "chart-wide")
  }
}
```

<div id="s3" class="sec-anchor"></div>

# 3 &mdash; Differential Expression

> **Complete pairwise contrast table** &mdash; every feature &times; every contrast,
> searchable, filterable, and downloadable as CSV or Excel. This is the single source
> of truth for downstream analyses (<code>result$differential_expression$contrasts</code>).

```{r s3-reference-info, results='asis'}
if (has_contrasts) {
  # Infer reference level(s) from contrast names ("B vs A" pattern -> A is reference).
  ref_levels <- tryCatch({
    parts <- strsplit(contrast_names, "\\s+vs\\s+")
    vapply(parts, function(p) if (length(p) == 2) p[2] else NA_character_,
           character(1))
  }, error = function(e) character(0))
  ref_levels <- unique(ref_levels[!is.na(ref_levels)])

  ref_txt <- if (length(ref_levels) == 1)
    paste0("<code>", htmlEscape(ref_levels), "</code>")
  else if (length(ref_levels) > 1)
    paste(sprintf("<code>%s</code>", htmlEscape(ref_levels)), collapse = ", ")
  else "<em>not determined automatically</em>"

  cv_txt <- if (!is.null(smry$contrast_variable))
    paste0("<code>", htmlEscape(smry$contrast_variable), "</code>")
  else "<em>not specified</em>"

  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    '<div class="ref-note"><strong>Contrast variable:</strong> %s &nbsp;&bull;&nbsp; ',
    '<strong>Reference level:</strong> %s &nbsp;&bull;&nbsp; ',
    '<strong>Contrasts:</strong> %d &nbsp;&bull;&nbsp; ',
    '<strong>Rows:</strong> %s</div>\n\n'),
    cv_txt, ref_txt, n_contrasts,
    format(nrow(contrasts_df), big.mark = ",")))
}
```

```{r s3-infobox, results='asis'}
cat(info_box(
  "Interpreting contrasts: link scale & reference",
  paste0(
    "<p>A pairwise contrast <code>B vs A</code> estimates <em>&mu;<sub>B</sub> &minus; ",
    "&mu;<sub>A</sub></em> on the <strong>link scale</strong>. The second name ",
    "(<code>A</code>) is the <strong>reference</strong>: a positive estimate means the ",
    "feature is higher in <code>B</code> than in <code>A</code>.</p>",
    "<ul>",
    "<li><strong>Log-link families</strong> (NBI, PO, ZIP, ZINBI, GA, GG, LOGNO, IG): ",
    "Estimate = log(fold-change). Fold-change = <code>exp(Estimate)</code>.</li>",
    "<li><strong>Logit-link families</strong> (BI, BB, BE, BEZI, BEO, BEINF): ",
    "Estimate = log-odds difference.</li>",
    "<li><strong>Identity-link families</strong> (NO, TF, GU): ",
    "Estimate = raw mean difference on the original scale.</li>",
    "</ul>",
    "<p>When there are more than two levels, <em>all</em> pairwise post-hoc contrasts ",
    "are reported (not just reference-vs-level). With only two levels, a single ",
    "<code>level vs reference</code> contrast appears. P-values are adjusted ",
    "<em>within</em> each contrast across all features using the method specified ",
    "in section 0.</p>"
  )
))
```

```{r s3-omnibus-infobox, results='asis', eval=has_omnibus}
cat(info_box(
  "Omnibus Test &mdash; global significance per feature",
  paste0(
    "<p>The <strong>omnibus test</strong> evaluates whether the contrast variable has ",
    "<em>any</em> effect on a feature, jointly across all levels, before any pairwise ",
    "contrast is computed.</p>",
    "<ul>",
    "<li><strong>Wald omnibus</strong>: W&nbsp;=&nbsp;&beta;'V<sup>&minus;1</sup>&beta;&nbsp;~&nbsp;&chi;<sup>2</sup>(df). ",
    "Fast, no refit. Large-sample asymptotics.</li>",
    "<li><strong>LRT</strong>: compares full vs. reduced model. More robust for small ",
    "samples but requires a second fit per feature.</li>",
    "</ul>",
    "<p>Acts as a <strong>gatekeeper</strong>: only features with ",
    "p&nbsp;&lt;&nbsp;omnibus_threshold proceed to pairwise contrast computation. ",
    "Features with <code>pass\u00a0=\u00a0FALSE</code> are excluded from the contrast table below.</p>"
  )
))
```

```{r contrasts-table}
if (has_contrasts && nrow(contrasts_df) > 0) {
  tbl <- contrasts_df
  if (!is.null(de$selection) && "best_family" %in% names(de$selection)) {
    tbl$best_family <- de$selection$best_family[match(tbl$feature,
                                                      de$selection$feature)]
  }

  keep <- intersect(
    c("feature", "contrast", "estimate", "se", "z", "p_value", "p_adj",
      "best_family"),
    names(tbl)
  )
  tbl <- tbl[, keep, drop = FALSE]

  # Round numeric columns
  for (nm in intersect(c("estimate", "se"), names(tbl)))
    tbl[[nm]] <- signif(tbl[[nm]], 4)
  if ("z"       %in% names(tbl)) tbl$z       <- round(tbl$z, 3)
  if ("p_value" %in% names(tbl)) tbl$p_value <- signif(tbl$p_value, 3)
  if ("p_adj"   %in% names(tbl)) tbl$p_adj   <- signif(tbl$p_adj, 3)

  if ("best_family" %in% names(tbl)) {
    tbl$best_family <- sapply(tbl$best_family, function(f)
      if (is.na(f) || f == "") "&mdash;" else family_badge(f))
  }

  dt <- datatable(
    tbl,
    rownames    = FALSE,
    escape      = FALSE,
    filter      = "top",
    caption     = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight:600;",
      "result$differential_expression$contrasts \u2014 all pairwise comparisons"
    ),
    extensions  = c("Buttons", "Scroller"),
    options     = list(
      dom         = "lBfrtip",
      buttons     = list(
        list(extend = "csv",   filename = "perseo_contrasts",
             text   = '<span>&#x2B07; CSV</span>'),
        list(extend = "excel", filename = "perseo_contrasts",
             title  = params$report_title,
             text   = '<span>&#x2B07; Excel</span>')
      ),
      scrollX    = TRUE,
      scrollY    = "500px",
      scroller   = TRUE,
      pageLength = 25
    )
  )
  if ("p_adj" %in% names(tbl)) {
    dt <- dt %>% formatStyle(
      "p_adj",
      background = styleInterval(c(0.01, 0.05),
                                 c("#ffe6e6", "#fff3e6", "white")))
  }
  dt
} else {
  HTML("<p><em>No contrast results available. Pass ",
       "<code>contrast_variable</code> to <code>run_perseo()</code> to enable ",
       "pairwise comparisons.</em></p>")
}
```

<div id="s4" class="sec-anchor"></div>

# 4 &mdash; Contrasts {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r s4-infobox, results='asis'}
cat(info_box(
  "How to read each tab",
  paste0(
    "<p>Each tab shows the results of one pairwise contrast <code>B vs A</code>. ",
    "The estimate (<strong>LFC</strong> &mdash; log fold-change for log-link families) ",
    "is <em>&mu;<sub>B</sub> &minus; &mu;<sub>A</sub></em> on the link scale. ",
    "Positive &rArr; higher in B (second name); negative &rArr; higher in A (reference).</p>",

    "<p><strong>Volcano plot</strong> &mdash; X: LFC, Y: &minus;log<sub>10</sub>(p-adj). ",
    "The top-right and top-left corners contain the most biologically and statistically ",
    "interesting features:</p>",
    "<ul>",
    "<li><span style='color:#0072B2;font-weight:700'>Blue &mdash; Sig &amp; LFC</span>: ",
    "passes both the FDR and the |LFC| threshold (what you usually want).</li>",
    "<li><span style='color:#56B4E9;font-weight:700'>Sky blue &mdash; FDR only</span>: ",
    "significant but small effect size.</li>",
    "<li><span style='color:#888888;font-weight:700'>Grey &mdash; LFC only</span>: ",
    "large effect but not statistically robust.</li>",
    "<li><span style='color:#BBBBBB;font-weight:700'>Light grey &mdash; Not sig</span>.</li>",
    "</ul>",
    "<p>Move the <em>FDR</em> and <em>|LFC|</em> sliders under each volcano to ",
    "re-classify the points live (the dashed reference lines remain fixed at the ",
    "initial thresholds &mdash; they are guides, not the cut-off).</p>",

    "<p><strong>MA plot</strong> &mdash; effect size vs. expression level. If significant ",
    "features cluster at one end of the X axis, effect size depends on expression level ",
    "(a signal of model miscalibration or mean-variance issues).</p>",

    "<p><strong>Boxplot (top 20 hits)</strong> &mdash; distribution of the raw signal ",
    "for the 20 most significant features in this contrast, grouped by the two contrasted ",
    "levels. Useful to eyeball effect size, variance, and outliers behind each LFC value.</p>",

    "<p><strong>Top 20 hits</strong> &mdash; the 20 features with the smallest adjusted ",
    "p-value for this contrast. The full table is in section 3.</p>"
  )
))
```

```{r contrast-sections, results='asis', eval=has_contrasts}
# Helper to compute a 5-number summary + outliers for ECharts boxplot.
.box_stats <- function(v) {
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  if (length(v) < 1) return(list(box = rep(NA_real_, 5), outliers = numeric(0)))
  q <- stats::quantile(v, c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), names = FALSE)
  iqr <- q[4] - q[2]
  out <- v[v < q[2] - 1.5 * iqr | v > q[4] + 1.5 * iqr]
  list(box = unname(q), outliers = unname(out))
}

.raw_counts <- if (!is.null(result$input_data)) result$input_data$counts_matrix else NULL
.raw_meta   <- if (!is.null(result$input_data)) result$input_data$metadata else NULL
.raw_cvar   <- if (!is.null(result$input_data)) result$input_data$contrast_variable else NULL

for (i in seq_along(contrast_names)) {
  cname <- contrast_names[i]
  slug  <- contrast_slugs[i]

  df_c <- contrasts_df[contrasts_df$contrast == cname, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(de$selection) && "best_family" %in% names(de$selection))
    df_c <- merge(df_c, de$selection[, c("feature", "best_family")],
                  by = "feature", all.x = TRUE)

  n_sig_c <- sum(!is.na(df_c$p_adj) &
                   df_c$p_adj < .fdr_threshold &
                   abs(df_c$estimate) >= .lfc_threshold,
                 na.rm = TRUE)

  cat(sprintf('\n## %s {#c-%s}\n\n', cname, slug))
  cat(sprintf('<div id="csec-%s">\n\n', slug))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d significant features</strong> (FDR&nbsp;&lt;&nbsp;%.3f &amp; |LFC|&nbsp;&ge;&nbsp;%.1f) out of %d tested.</p>\n\n",
    n_sig_c, .fdr_threshold, .lfc_threshold, nrow(df_c)))

  # -------- Volcano (ECharts) --------
  cat("### Volcano plot\n\n")
  volc_rows <- data.frame(
    feature   = df_c$feature,
    estimate  = df_c$estimate,
    p_adj     = df_c$p_adj,
    neg_log10 = ifelse(is.finite(df_c$p_adj) & df_c$p_adj > 0,
                       -log10(df_c$p_adj), NA_real_),
    colour    = classify_colour(df_c$estimate, df_c$p_adj),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  volc_payload <- list(
    rows      = volc_rows,
    fdr       = .fdr_threshold,
    lfc       = .lfc_threshold,
    slug      = slug
  )
  print(emit_chart(sprintf("volcano-%s", slug), "volcano", volc_payload,
                   min_h = "460px", extra_class = "chart-tall"))
  cat("\n\n")

  cat(sprintf(
    paste0('<div class="volcano-controls" id="ctrl-%s" data-chart="volcano-%s">\n',
           '  <div class="vc-group"><label>FDR threshold:&nbsp;',
           '<span class="vc-val fdr-val">%.3f</span></label>',
           '<input type="range" class="fdr-slider" min="0.001" max="0.25" step="0.005" value="%.3f"></div>\n',
           '  <div class="vc-group"><label>|LFC| min:&nbsp;',
           '<span class="vc-val lfc-val">%.1f</span></label>',
           '<input type="range" class="lfc-slider" min="0" max="5" step="0.1" value="%.1f"></div>\n',
           '  <div class="vc-summary">Sig &amp; LFC:&nbsp;<strong class="sig-count">%d</strong></div>\n',
           '  <span class="vc-note">Points recolour live; dashed reference lines follow the sliders.</span>\n',
           '</div>\n\n'),
    slug, slug,
    .fdr_threshold, .fdr_threshold,
    .lfc_threshold, .lfc_threshold,
    n_sig_c))

  # -------- MA plot (ECharts) --------
  cat("### MA plot\n\n")
  ma_rows <- df_c
  base_mean_col <- intersect(c("base_mean", "mean_expr", "mean"), names(ma_rows))[1]
  if (is.na(base_mean_col)) {
    if (!is.null(.raw_counts)) {
      bm <- rowMeans(.raw_counts[match(ma_rows$feature, rownames(.raw_counts)), ,
                                 drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      ma_rows$base_mean <- log2(pmax(bm, 1e-6))
    } else {
      ma_rows$base_mean <- rank(ma_rows$feature) / length(ma_rows$feature)
    }
    base_mean_col <- "base_mean"
  }
  ma_payload <- list(
    rows = data.frame(
      feature  = ma_rows$feature,
      x        = ma_rows[[base_mean_col]],
      estimate = ma_rows$estimate,
      p_adj    = ma_rows$p_adj,
      colour   = classify_colour(ma_rows$estimate, ma_rows$p_adj),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    lfc = .lfc_threshold,
    xlab = if (base_mean_col == "base_mean") "log2 mean expression" else base_mean_col
  )
  print(emit_chart(sprintf("ma-%s", slug), "ma", ma_payload,
                   min_h = "380px"))
  cat("\n\n")

  # -------- Boxplot (ECharts) --------
  cat("### Boxplot (top 20 hits)\n\n")
  if (!is.null(.raw_counts) && !is.null(.raw_meta) && !is.null(.raw_cvar)) {
    # Contrast names may use "_vs_" (from build_contrast_matrix) or " vs "
    cname_norm <- gsub("_vs_", " vs ", cname)
    parts <- strsplit(cname_norm, "\\s+vs\\s+")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) == 2 && .raw_cvar %in% names(.raw_meta)) {
      gB <- parts[1]; gA <- parts[2]
      grp_vec <- as.character(.raw_meta[[.raw_cvar]])
      sA <- which(grp_vec == gA); sB <- which(grp_vec == gB)

      top_feats <- df_c$feature[order(df_c$p_adj, na.last = NA)]
      top_feats <- head(intersect(top_feats, rownames(.raw_counts)), 20)

      if (length(top_feats) > 0 && length(sA) > 0 && length(sB) > 0) {
        box_A <- lapply(top_feats, function(f) .box_stats(.raw_counts[f, sA]))
        box_B <- lapply(top_feats, function(f) .box_stats(.raw_counts[f, sB]))
        out_A <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(top_feats), function(k) {
          o <- box_A[[k]]$outliers
          if (length(o)) data.frame(feat = k - 1, value = o) else NULL
        }))
        out_B <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(top_feats), function(k) {
          o <- box_B[[k]]$outliers
          if (length(o)) data.frame(feat = k - 1, value = o) else NULL
        }))
        box_payload <- list(
          features = top_feats,
          groupA   = gA, groupB = gB,
          boxA     = lapply(box_A, function(b) b$box),
          boxB     = lapply(box_B, function(b) b$box),
          outA     = if (is.null(out_A)) list() else out_A,
          outB     = if (is.null(out_B)) list() else out_B
        )
        print(emit_chart(sprintf("box-%s", slug), "boxplot", box_payload,
                         min_h = "400px", extra_class = "chart-wide"))
        cat("\n\n")
      } else {
        cat("> *Not enough samples or features to render a boxplot for this contrast.*\n\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("> *Contrast name could not be parsed as `B vs A` \u2014 boxplot skipped.*\n\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("> *Raw data not available on this result object. Re-run `run_perseo()` to enable boxplots.*\n\n")
  }

  # --- Top 20 hits table (preview) ---
  tryCatch({
    cat("### Top 20 hits\n\n")
    top_tbl <- df_c %>%
      filter(!is.na(p_adj)) %>%
      arrange(p_adj) %>%
      head(20) %>%
      mutate(
        across(any_of(c("estimate", "se")), ~ signif(., 4)),
        across(any_of("z"),       ~ round(., 3)),
        across(any_of("p_value"), ~ signif(., 3)),
        across(any_of("p_adj"),   ~ signif(., 3))
      ) %>%
      select(any_of(c("feature", "estimate", "se", "z", "p_value", "p_adj",
                      "best_family")))

    if ("best_family" %in% names(top_tbl)) {
      top_tbl$best_family <- sapply(top_tbl$best_family, function(f)
        if (!is.na(f)) family_badge(f) else "&mdash;")
    }

    print(tagList(
      datatable(top_tbl, rownames = FALSE, escape = FALSE,
                options = list(pageLength = 20, dom = "tip", scrollX = TRUE))
    ))
    cat("\n\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("> *Table error: %s*\n\n", conditionMessage(e)))
  })

  cat('</div>\n\n')
}
```

```{r venn-upset, results='asis', eval=show_comparison}
sig_sets <- lapply(setNames(nm = contrast_names), function(cn) {
  dfc <- contrasts_df[contrasts_df$contrast == cn, ]
  unique(dfc$feature[!is.na(dfc$p_adj) & dfc$p_adj < .fdr_threshold &
                       abs(dfc$estimate) >= .lfc_threshold])
})

n_c <- length(contrast_names)
all_feats <- unique(unlist(sig_sets))

if (n_c >= 2 && length(all_feats) > 0) {
  # Compute membership matrix: features x sets
  mem <- vapply(sig_sets, function(s) all_feats %in% s, logical(length(all_feats)))

  if (n_c <= 4) {
    # Enumerate all 2^n_c - 1 exclusive regions
    regions <- lapply(seq_len(2^n_c - 1), function(mask_int) {
      mask <- as.logical(intToBits(mask_int)[seq_len(n_c)])
      cnt <- if (length(all_feats) > 0)
        sum(apply(mem, 1, function(m) identical(m, mask)))
      else 0L
      list(sets = which(mask) - 1L, size = cnt)
    })
    venn_payload <- list(
      sets    = contrast_names,
      sizes   = vapply(sig_sets, length, integer(1)),
      regions = regions,
      fdr     = .fdr_threshold,
      lfc     = .lfc_threshold
    )
    emit_chart("chart-venn", "venn", venn_payload,
               min_h = "420px", extra_class = "chart-wide")
  } else {
    # UpSet-style for >4 contrasts.
    # paste(logical) → "TRUEFALSE..." so we must convert to 0/1 first.
    int_patterns <- apply(mem, 1, function(m) paste(as.integer(m), collapse = ""))
    unique_pats  <- unique(int_patterns)
    upset_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique_pats, function(pat) {
      bits <- as.logical(as.integer(strsplit(pat, "")[[1]]))
      cnt  <- sum(int_patterns == pat)
      data.frame(
        pattern = pat,
        count   = cnt,
        n_sets  = sum(bits),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))
    upset_rows <- upset_rows[upset_rows$count > 0, ]
    upset_rows <- head(upset_rows[order(-upset_rows$count), ], 30L)

    # Short labels for display (strip "Treatment" prefix to save space)
    short_sets <- gsub("_vs_", " vs ", contrast_names)

    upset_payload <- list(
      sets   = short_sets,
      rows   = upset_rows,
      sizes  = vapply(sig_sets, length, integer(1)),
      fdr    = .fdr_threshold,
      lfc    = .lfc_threshold
    )
    h_dot  <- max(200L, n_c * 28L)
    h_bar  <- 200L
    emit_chart("chart-venn", "upset", upset_payload,
               min_h = paste0(h_bar + h_dot + 120L, "px"),
               extra_class = "chart-wide")
  }
} else if (n_c >= 2) {
  cat("> *No significant features found at the current thresholds — Venn diagram empty.*\n\n")
}
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ---- Shared constants ---- */
  var COLOURS = { sig_lfc:"#0072B2", fdr_only:"#56B4E9", lfc_only:"#888888", not_sig:"#BBBBBB" };
  var TOOLTIP_BASE = {
    backgroundColor:"white", borderColor:"#2C3E50", borderWidth:1,
    textStyle:{ color:"#2C3E50", fontSize:12, fontFamily:"Helvetica Neue,Arial,sans-serif" },
    extraCssText:"box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.12);border-radius:6px;"
  };
  var ZOOM_TOOLBOX = {
    feature: { dataZoom:{ yAxisIndex:"none" }, restore:{}, saveAsImage:{ pixelRatio:2 } }
  };

  /* ---- Utilities ---- */
  function classify(est, pAdj, fdr, lfc) {
    if (est==null||pAdj==null||!isFinite(est)||!isFinite(pAdj)) return "not_sig";
    var al=Math.abs(est);
    if (pAdj<fdr&&al>=lfc) return "sig_lfc";
    if (pAdj<fdr)           return "fdr_only";
    if (al>=lfc)            return "lfc_only";
    return "not_sig";
  }
  function readCfg(el) {
    var n=document.getElementById("cfg-"+el.id);
    if(!n) return null;
    try{ return JSON.parse(n.textContent); }catch(e){ return null; }
  }
  function tt(o) { return Object.assign({},TOOLTIP_BASE,o); }

  /* ---- Volcano ---- */
  function initVolcano(el, cfg) {
    var chart=echarts.init(el);
    var rows=cfg.rows||[], fdr=cfg.fdr, lfc=cfg.lfc;

    function mkData(rows){ return rows.map(function(r){
      return { value:[r.estimate,r.neg_log10], name:r.feature,
               p_adj:r.p_adj, itemStyle:{color:r.colour} }; }); }
    function mkML(fdr,lfc){ return {
      symbol:"none",silent:true,animation:false,
      lineStyle:{type:"dashed",color:"#888"},
      data:[{xAxis:lfc},{xAxis:-lfc},{yAxis:fdr>0?-Math.log(fdr)/Math.LN10:0}] }; }

    chart.setOption({
      toolbox: ZOOM_TOOLBOX,
      dataZoom:[{type:"inside"},{type:"slider",bottom:0,height:16}],
      grid:{left:60,right:30,top:30,bottom:70},
      xAxis:{name:"Log Fold Change",nameLocation:"middle",nameGap:32,
             splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:"#EEE"}}},
      yAxis:{name:"-log\u2081\u2080(p-adj)",nameLocation:"middle",nameGap:48,
             splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:"#EEE"}}},
      tooltip:tt({trigger:"item",formatter:function(p){
        var r=p.data;
        return "<b>"+r.name+"</b><br/>LFC: "+r.value[0].toFixed(3)
              +"<br/>p-adj: "+(r.p_adj==null?"NA":r.p_adj.toExponential(2)); }}),
      series:[{type:"scatter",symbolSize:7,data:mkData(rows),markLine:mkML(fdr,lfc)}]
    });

    chart.__perseoRefresh=function(newFdr,newLfc){
      var count=0;
      var d=rows.map(function(r){
        var cat=classify(r.estimate,r.p_adj,newFdr,newLfc);
        if(cat==="sig_lfc")count++;
        return {value:[r.estimate,r.neg_log10],name:r.feature,
                p_adj:r.p_adj,itemStyle:{color:COLOURS[cat]}};
      });
      chart.setOption({series:[{data:d,markLine:mkML(newFdr,newLfc)}]});
      return count;
    };
    return chart;
  }

  /* ---- MA plot ---- */
  function initMA(el, cfg) {
    var chart=echarts.init(el);
    var rows=cfg.rows||[];
    chart.setOption({
      toolbox:ZOOM_TOOLBOX,
      dataZoom:[{type:"inside"},{type:"slider",bottom:0,height:16}],
      grid:{left:65,right:30,top:30,bottom:70},
      xAxis:{name:cfg.xlab||"x",nameLocation:"middle",nameGap:32,
             splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:"#EEE"}}},
      yAxis:{name:"Log Fold Change",nameLocation:"middle",nameGap:48,
             splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:"#EEE"}}},
      tooltip:tt({trigger:"item",formatter:function(p){
        var r=p.data;
        return "<b>"+r.name+"</b><br/>x: "+r.value[0].toFixed(3)
              +"<br/>LFC: "+r.value[1].toFixed(3)
              +"<br/>p-adj: "+(r.p_adj==null?"NA":r.p_adj.toExponential(2)); }}),
      series:[{type:"scatter",symbolSize:6,
        data:rows.map(function(r){
          return {value:[r.x,r.estimate],name:r.feature,p_adj:r.p_adj,
                  itemStyle:{color:r.colour}}; }),
        markLine:{symbol:"none",silent:true,animation:false,
          lineStyle:{type:"dashed",color:"#888"},
          data:[{yAxis:0},{yAxis:cfg.lfc},{yAxis:-cfg.lfc}]} }]
    });
    return chart;
  }

  /* ---- Boxplot ---- */
  function initBoxplot(el, cfg) {
    var chart=echarts.init(el);
    var feats=cfg.features||[];
    var bA=(cfg.boxA||[]).map(function(b){return b.map(Number);});
    var bB=(cfg.boxB||[]).map(function(b){return b.map(Number);});
    var oA=(cfg.outA||[]).map(function(o){return [o.feat,o.value];});
    var oB=(cfg.outB||[]).map(function(o){return [o.feat,o.value];});
    chart.setOption({
      legend:{data:[cfg.groupA,cfg.groupB],top:0},
      toolbox:ZOOM_TOOLBOX,
      grid:{left:75,right:20,top:40,bottom:90},
      xAxis:{type:"category",data:feats,
             axisLabel:{rotate:40,fontSize:10,interval:0},
             splitArea:{show:true,areaStyle:{color:["#FAFAFA","#FFFFFF"]}}},
      yAxis:{nameLocation:"middle",nameGap:55,
             splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:"#EEE"}}},
      tooltip:tt({trigger:"item",formatter:function(p){
        if(p.seriesType==="boxplot"){
          var v=p.data;
          return "<b>"+feats[p.dataIndex]+"</b> — "+p.seriesName
                +"<br/>min: "+Number(v[1]).toFixed(3)
                +"<br/>Q1: " +Number(v[2]).toFixed(3)
                +"<br/>med: "+Number(v[3]).toFixed(3)
                +"<br/>Q3: " +Number(v[4]).toFixed(3)
                +"<br/>max: "+Number(v[5]).toFixed(3); }
        return p.seriesName+": "+Number(p.value[1]).toFixed(3); }}),
      series:[
        {name:cfg.groupA,type:"boxplot",
         itemStyle:{color:"#AED6F1",borderColor:"#2980B9"},data:bA},
        {name:cfg.groupB,type:"boxplot",
         itemStyle:{color:"#A3E4D7",borderColor:"#17A589"},data:bB},
        {name:cfg.groupA+" out",type:"scatter",symbolSize:5,
         itemStyle:{color:"#2980B9"},data:oA},
        {name:cfg.groupB+" out",type:"scatter",symbolSize:5,
         itemStyle:{color:"#17A589"},data:oB}
      ]
    });
    return chart;
  }

  /* ---- Family bar ---- */
  function initFamilyBar(el, cfg) {
    var chart=echarts.init(el);
    var rows=(cfg.rows||[]).slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.n-b.n;});
    chart.setOption({
      grid:{left:80,right:60,top:20,bottom:30},
      xAxis:{type:"value",name:"Features",splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:"#EEE"}}},
      yAxis:{type:"category",data:rows.map(function(r){return r.family;}),
             axisLabel:{fontSize:11}},
      tooltip:tt({trigger:"item",formatter:function(p){
        return "<b>"+p.name+"</b><br/>"+p.data.full
              +"<br/>Features: "+p.value+" ("+p.data.pct.toFixed(1)+"%)"; }}),
      series:[{type:"bar",
        data:rows.map(function(r){
          return {value:r.n,pct:r.pct,full:r.full||r.family,
                  itemStyle:{color:r.colour||"#2C6E9B"}}; }),
        label:{show:true,position:"right",fontSize:11,
               formatter:function(p){return p.value+" ("+p.data.pct.toFixed(1)+"%)";}} }]
    });
    return chart;
  }

  /* ---- IC Histogram ---- */
  function initICHist(el, cfg) {
    var chart=echarts.init(el);
    var mids=cfg.bin_mids||[];
    var PAL=["#2C3E50", "#2980B9", "#17A589", "#5D6D7E", "#5DADE2",
             "#48C9B0", "#34495E", "#85C1E9", "#76D7C4", "#85929E",
             "#1A5276", "#0E6251", "#AEB6BF", "#AED6F1", "#A3E4D7"];
    var series=(cfg.series||[]).map(function(s,i){
      return {name:s.name||s.family,type:"bar",stack:"ic",
              itemStyle:{color:s.colour||PAL[i%PAL.length]},data:s.counts}; });
    chart.setOption({
      legend:{top:0,type:"scroll"},
      grid:{left:60,right:25,top:50,bottom:55},
      xAxis:{type:"category",data:mids.map(function(m){return Number(m).toFixed(1);}),
             name:"IC (BIC / AIC)",nameLocation:"middle",nameGap:32},
      yAxis:{type:"value",name:"Count",nameLocation:"middle",nameGap:45},
      tooltip:tt({trigger:"axis",axisPointer:{type:"shadow"}}),
      series:series
    });
    return chart;
  }

  /* ---- LFC Heatmap ---- */
  function initHeatmap(el, cfg) {
    var chart=echarts.init(el);
    var feats=cfg.features||[], conts=cfg.contrasts||[], lim=cfg.lfc_lim||3;
    var fi={},ci={};
    feats.forEach(function(f,i){fi[f]=i;});
    conts.forEach(function(c,i){ci[c]=i;});
    var data=(cfg.cells||[]).map(function(r){
      return [ci[r.contrast],fi[r.feature],r.estimate,r.feature,r.contrast,r.p_adj]; });
    chart.setOption({
      grid:{left:140,right:50,top:30,bottom:80},
      xAxis:{type:"category",data:conts,axisLabel:{rotate:40,fontSize:10}},
      yAxis:{type:"category",data:feats,axisLabel:{fontSize:10}},
      visualMap:{min:-lim,max:lim,calculable:true,orient:"vertical",
        right:5,top:"center",
        inRange:{color:["#5DADE2","#FFFFFF","#2C3E50"]},text:["+LFC","-LFC"]},
      tooltip:tt({formatter:function(p){
        return "<b>"+p.data[3]+"</b><br/>"+p.data[4]
              +"<br/>LFC: "+(p.data[2]==null?"NA":Number(p.data[2]).toFixed(3))
              +"<br/>p-adj: "+(p.data[5]==null?"NA":Number(p.data[5]).toExponential(2));}}),
      series:[{type:"heatmap",
        data:data.map(function(d){
          return {value:[d[0],d[1],d[2]],raw:d,
                  itemStyle:d[2]==null?{color:"#EEE"}:undefined}; }) }]
    });
    return chart;
  }

  /* ---- Venn SVG (≤4 sets) ---- */
  function initVenn(el, cfg) {
    var sets=cfg.sets||[], regions=cfg.regions||[], n=sets.length;
    var W=560, H=380, R=120;
    /* Circle centres for 2, 3, 4 sets */
    var CX, CY;
    if(n===2){ CX=[W/2-70,W/2+70]; CY=[H/2,H/2]; }
    else if(n===3){ CX=[W/2-80,W/2+80,W/2]; CY=[H/2-55,H/2-55,H/2+75]; }
    else{ CX=[W/2-75,W/2+75,W/2-75,W/2+75]; CY=[H/2-55,H/2-55,H/2+55,H/2+55]; }

    /* Approximate label positions per exclusive region */
    function regionLabel(mask) {
      /* weighted centroid of included circles */
      var sx=0,sy=0,k=0;
      mask.forEach(function(idx){sx+=CX[idx];sy+=CY[idx];k++;});
      var cx=sx/k, cy=sy/k;
      /* Push toward centroid if single-set (outer region) */
      if(mask.length===1){
        var i=mask[0]; var wx=W/2,wy=H/2;
        cx=CX[i]+(CX[i]-wx)*0.45; cy=CY[i]+(CY[i]-wy)*0.45;
      }
      return {x:cx,y:cy};
    }

    var FILL=["#AED6F1","#A3E4D7","#D5DBDB","#85C1E9",
              "#A9DFBF","#D6EAF8","#E5E8E8","#A2D9CE"];
    var STROKE=["#2980B9","#17A589","#7F8C8D","#2471A3",
                "#27AE60","#3498DB","#AEB6BF","#1ABC9C"];

    var circles=sets.map(function(s,i){
      return '<circle cx="'+CX[i]+'" cy="'+CY[i]+'" r="'+R+'"'
            +' fill="'+FILL[i%FILL.length]+'" fill-opacity="0.35"'
            +' stroke="'+STROKE[i%STROKE.length]+'" stroke-width="2"/>';
    }).join("");

    var labels=sets.map(function(s,i){
      var lx=CX[i]+(CX[i]-W/2)*0.28, ly=CY[i]+(CY[i]-H/2)*0.28-R*0.65;
      return '<text x="'+lx+'" y="'+ly+'" text-anchor="middle"'
            +' font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="'+STROKE[i%STROKE.length]+'">'+escSVG(s)+'</text>';
    }).join("");

    var counts=regions.map(function(reg){
      if(reg.size===0) return "";
      var pos=regionLabel(reg.sets);
      return '<text x="'+pos.x+'" y="'+(pos.y+5)+'" text-anchor="middle"'
            +' font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#2C3E50">'+reg.size+'</text>';
    }).join("");

    var totalSig=cfg.sizes?cfg.sizes.reduce(function(a,b){return a+b;},0):0;
    var caption="FDR&lt;"+cfg.fdr+" &amp; |LFC|&ge;"+cfg.lfc;

    el.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 '+W+' '+H+'" style="width:100%;max-height:420px">'
      +'<text x="'+W/2+'" y="22" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">'
      +'Significant feature overlap</text>'
      +'<text x="'+W/2+'" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#888">'+caption+'</text>'
      +circles+labels+counts
      +'</svg>';
    return {resize:function(){}};
  }
  function escSVG(s){return s.replace(/&/g,"&amp;").replace(/</g,"&lt;").replace(/>/g,"&gt;");}

  /* ---- UpSet chart (>4 sets via ECharts) ---- */
  function initUpset(el, cfg) {
    var sets  = cfg.sets || [];
    var rows  = (cfg.rows || []).slice(0, 20);
    var nS    = sets.length;
    var nR    = rows.length;
    if (nR === 0) {
      el.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;padding:40px;color:#888">No intersections to display.</p>';
      return { resize: function(){} };
    }

    /* Decode pattern "1001.." -> array of 0/1 */
    function bits(pat) {
      return (pat || "").split("").map(Number);
    }

    var SET_COLS = ["#2980B9", "#17A589", "#7F8C8D", "#2471A3", "#27AE60",
                    "#3498DB", "#AEB6BF", "#1ABC9C", "#34495E", "#5DADE2"];

    var BAR_H   = 200;
    var DOT_ROW = 26;
    var TOP     = 45;
    var LEFT    = 140;
    var DOT_TOP = BAR_H + TOP + 30;

    var chart = echarts.init(el);

    /* Bar series */
    var barSeries = {
      type:"bar", xAxisIndex:0, yAxisIndex:0,
      data: rows.map(function(r){ return r.count||0; }),
      itemStyle:{ color:"#2C6E9B" },
      label:{ show:true, position:"top", fontSize:11,
              formatter:function(p){ return p.value>0?p.value:""; } }
    };

    /* One scatter series per set — dots where that set is in the intersection */
    var dotSeries = sets.map(function(s, si){
      var colFill  = SET_COLS[si % SET_COLS.length];
      var data = [];
      rows.forEach(function(r, ri){
        var b = bits(r.pattern);
        if (b[si] === 1) data.push({ value:[ri, si], ri:ri });
      });
      return {
        type:"scatter", xAxisIndex:1, yAxisIndex:1,
        symbolSize:12,
        itemStyle:{ color:colFill },
        data: data,
        z: 5
      };
    });

    /* Grey background dots for "not in set" positions */
    var greyData = [];
    rows.forEach(function(r, ri){
      var b = bits(r.pattern);
      b.forEach(function(v, si){ if(v===0) greyData.push([ri,si]); });
    });
    var greySeries = {
      type:"scatter", xAxisIndex:1, yAxisIndex:1,
      symbolSize:10,
      itemStyle:{ color:"#DDD" },
      data:greyData, z:3
    };

    /* Vertical connectors via custom series — safer than markLine on empty series */
    var connData = [];
    rows.forEach(function(r, ri){
      var b = bits(r.pattern);
      var active = [];
      b.forEach(function(v,si){ if(v===1) active.push(si); });
      if(active.length > 1){
        connData.push({ ri:ri, minSi:active[0], maxSi:active[active.length-1] });
      }
    });
    var connSeries = {
      type:"custom", xAxisIndex:1, yAxisIndex:1,
      z:4, silent:true,
      renderItem: function(params, api){
        var cri    = params.dataIndex;
        var d      = connData[cri];
        var p0     = api.coord([d.ri, d.minSi]);
        var p1     = api.coord([d.ri, d.maxSi]);
        return { type:"line",
          shape:{ x1:p0[0], y1:p0[1], x2:p1[0], y2:p1[1] },
          style:{ stroke:"#2C6E9B", lineWidth:3 } };
      },
      data: connData.map(function(d){ return [d.ri, d.minSi]; })
    };

    var xCats = rows.map(function(_,i){ return i+1; });

    chart.setOption({
      grid:[
        { left:LEFT, right:20, top:TOP,      height:BAR_H      },
        { left:LEFT, right:20, top:DOT_TOP,  height:nS*DOT_ROW }
      ],
      xAxis:[
        { gridIndex:0, type:"category", data:xCats,
          axisLabel:{show:false}, axisTick:{show:false}, axisLine:{show:false} },
        { gridIndex:1, type:"category", data:xCats,
          axisLabel:{show:false}, axisTick:{show:false}, axisLine:{show:false} }
      ],
      yAxis:[
        { gridIndex:0, type:"value", name:"Intersection size",
          nameLocation:"middle", nameGap:50,
          splitLine:{lineStyle:{color:"#EEE"}}, min:0 },
        { gridIndex:1, type:"category", data:sets,
          axisLabel:{ fontSize:11, width:130, overflow:"truncate" },
          axisTick:{show:false}, splitLine:{show:false} }
      ],
      tooltip: tt({ trigger:"item", formatter:function(p){
        if(p.seriesType==="bar"){
          var r=rows[p.dataIndex];
          var b=bits(r.pattern);
          var names=[];
          b.forEach(function(v,si){if(v===1)names.push(sets[si]);});
          return "<b>"+p.value+" features</b><br/>"+names.join("<br/>");
        }
        return "";
      }}),
      series: [barSeries, connSeries, greySeries].concat(dotSeries)
    });
    return chart;
  }

  /* ---- Dispatch map ---- */
  var DISPATCH = {
    volcano:initVolcano, ma:initMA, boxplot:initBoxplot,
    family_bar:initFamilyBar, ic_hist:initICHist,
    venn:initVenn, upset:initUpset
  };

  var charts=[];

  function initAllCharts() {
    if(typeof echarts==="undefined") return;
    document.querySelectorAll(".perseo-chart").forEach(function(el){
      if(el.__perseoInit) return;
      var type=el.getAttribute("data-chart-type");
      var cfg=readCfg(el), fn=DISPATCH[type];
      if(!fn||!cfg) return;
      try{
        var c=fn(el,cfg);
        el.__perseoInit=true; el.__perseoChart=c;
        if(c&&typeof c.resize==="function") charts.push(c);
      }catch(e){ console.error("Chart init failed:",type,e); }
    });
  }

  function wireVolcanoSliders() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".volcano-controls").forEach(function(ctrl){
      var tid=ctrl.getAttribute("data-chart");
      var target=tid?document.getElementById(tid):null;
      if(!target) return;
      var fs=ctrl.querySelector(".fdr-slider"), ls=ctrl.querySelector(".lfc-slider");
      var fd=ctrl.querySelector(".fdr-val"),  ld=ctrl.querySelector(".lfc-val");
      var cd=ctrl.querySelector(".sig-count");
      if(!fs||!ls) return;
      function upd(){
        var fdr=parseFloat(fs.value), lfc=parseFloat(ls.value);
        if(fd) fd.textContent=fdr.toFixed(3);
        if(ld) ld.textContent=lfc.toFixed(1);
        if(target.__perseoChart&&target.__perseoChart.__perseoRefresh){
          var n=target.__perseoChart.__perseoRefresh(fdr,lfc);
          if(cd) cd.textContent=n;
        }
      }
      fs.addEventListener("input",upd); ls.addEventListener("input",upd);
    });
  }

  function wireSidebar() {
    var links=document.querySelectorAll("#perseo-nav a");
    var obs=[];
    links.forEach(function(link){
      var h=link.getAttribute("href");
      if(h&&h.charAt(0)==="#"){ var el=document.getElementById(h.substring(1));
        if(el) obs.push({link:link,el:el}); }
    });
    if(obs.length&&"IntersectionObserver"in window){
      var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
        entries.forEach(function(e){
          if(e.isIntersecting){
            links.forEach(function(l){l.classList.remove("active");});
            var a=document.querySelector("#perseo-nav a[href=\"#"+e.target.id+"\"]");
            if(a) a.classList.add("active");
          }
        });
      },{rootMargin:"-10% 0px -65% 0px",threshold:0});
      obs.forEach(function(item){io.observe(item.el);});
    }
    links.forEach(function(link){
      var h=link.getAttribute("href");
      if(!h||h.charAt(0)!=="#") return;
      var id=h.substring(1), target=document.getElementById(id);
      if(!target) return;
      var isTab=(target.className||"").indexOf("section")!==-1
               &&(target.closest&&target.closest(".tabset"));
      if(!isTab) return;
      link.addEventListener("click",function(ev){
        var tl=document.querySelector("ul.nav-pills a[href=\"#"+id+"\"],ul.nav-tabs a[href=\"#"+id+"\"]");
        if(tl){
          ev.preventDefault();
          if(window.jQuery) window.jQuery(tl).tab("show"); else tl.click();
          setTimeout(function(){target.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"});},50);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function resizeAll(){ charts.forEach(function(c){try{c.resize();}catch(e){}}); }

  window.addEventListener("load",function(){
    initAllCharts();
    wireVolcanoSliders();
    wireSidebar();
    window.addEventListener("resize",resizeAll);
    if(window.jQuery){
      window.jQuery(document).on("shown.bs.tab",function(){setTimeout(resizeAll,50);});
    }
  });
}());
</script>
```
